# KPI: Operating Cash Flow
**Domain:** Finance | **Owner:** Finance Analytics | **Refresh:** Monthly
**Definition:** Cash generated by normal business operations.
**Formula:** Net Profit + Non-Cash Expenses ± Working Capital Changes
**Source Tables:** fact_gl
**Used In Reports:** Budget Tracking Dashboard (Power BI), Budget vs Actual Report (SSRS)
**Notes:** Operating Cash Flow is part of the Finance KPI catalog.
